option_relations.rationale: Cutaneous cryptococcosis is a subtype of Cryptococcosis, which is a fungal infection caused by Cryptococcus neoformans.
Primary cutaneous cryptococcosis (PCC) is a subtype of Cryptococcosis, which is a fungal infection caused by Cryptococcus neoformans.
Cutaneous cryptococcal infection with systemic dissemination is a subtype of Cryptococcosis, which is a fungal infection caused by Cryptococcus neoformans.
Deep Fungal Infection (e.g., Sporotrichosis) is a different type of fungal infection, not related to Cryptococcosis.
